articles.headline: Kick It Out: Discrimination 'deeply embedded' in football, reports up 25%
articles.description: Discrimination remains "deeply embedded" in English football, the chief executive of Kick It Out has said, with reports up 25%  last season compared to the prior campaign.

articles.headline: Ex-Arsenal midfielder Aaron Ramsey named Oxford United manager
articles.description: Aaron Ramsey has stepped into management by taking the reins at Oxford United.

articles.headline: Notts County beat David Beckham's Salford in League Two playoff final
articles.description: Sir David Beckham made an unhappy Wembley Stadium return as Notts County beat the Salford side he co-owns 3-0 to win the League Two playoff final.

article.headline: Wrexham beat Mansfield to close gap at top of League 1
article.description: Wrexham moved maintained their push for promotion from League 1 with a 2-1 win over Mansfield Town on Sunday.
article.linkText: Wrexham beat Mansfield to continue promotion push
article.story:
Wrexham maintained their push for promotion from League 1 with a 2-1 win over Mansfield Town on Sunday.

A comical Calum Macdonald own goal and a second-half Max Cleworth strike took the Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney-owned side to within three points of second-place Wycombe Wanderers.

The only blemish for Wrexham was the injury to Andy Cannon, who had to be stretchered off in the first half after a challenge with Louis Reed.

Wrexham took a 2nd-minute lead at One Call Stadium after Macdonald bundled into his own net from Ollie Rathbone's cross. But, the defender made amends in the 15th minute with a sliding finish to bring the hosts level. 

Mansfield struggled to carry their momentum into the second half before Cleworth's low shot from outside the box near the hour-mark restored Wrexham's lead.

It was the centre-back's eighth goal of the season and proved the winner on the evening, as Wrexham took advantage of Wycombe and Birmingham City both dropping points this weekend.
